predecessor_dispositions.planner_multistep_grpo_value_v4: rejected: 35B was 0.9875 but 4B was already 0.883333; no complete family reached a 0.20 gap

objective: Test the retry-versus-migrate soft boundary after a required detector result, using matched gateway-error aliases where only retryability and consumed retry budget determine the second action.

design.type: blocked matched-state calibration followed by frozen confirmation
design.blocking: Every entity contains every detector-by-state-contract family.
design.matched_counterfactual: Within each family the same gateway_error alias appears in both actions; retryable/retry_count is the causal state difference.
design.shortcut_ceiling: An always-migrate policy scores at most 0.60 and an always-retry policy at most 0.40.
design.gold_trajectory: required detector(finish_after_tool=false), then migration_advisor or the same detector according to current structured state

calibration.balanced_selection: Select the first four admitted Qwen and first four admitted Rex families in frozen order.

confirmation.generation_condition: Generate only after the eight calibration families are frozen.
confirmation.promotion_note: Three repeats remain mandatory before using this as a release regression claim.

invalid_run_conditions: any infrastructure or API fallback error

analysis.future_grpo_value_contrast: SFT+GRPO minus the same SFT-only initializer; current 35B/4B separation identifies the target behavior but is not itself causal evidence for GRPO.
analysis.future_training_gate: Audit stochastic support at target step 2 before GRPO and add SFT warm-up only if positive support is absent.
